newsitem.title: USA: Chase arranges credit facility for Patriot.
newsitem.headline: Chase arranges credit facility for Patriot.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp's 's Chase Manhattan Bank said Wednesday it has arranged a $700 million unsecured credit revolving credit facility for Patriot American Hospitality Inc.
Chase said it arranged the credit facility with PaineWebber Real Estate Securities.
The revolver is the first stage of $1.2 billion credit facility for Patriot.

The remaining $500 million will be arranged exclusively by Chase and PaineWebber and will be in the form of a non-recourse, five-year term loan which may be structured and sold as commercial mortgage backed securities.
Chase said it expects the $500 million portion of the credit facility to close in the fall to coincide with Patriot's acquisition of Wyndham Hotel Corp.
The facility was co-arranged by Bankers Trust Co, Citicorp Real Estate Inc and Merrill Lynch Capital Corp.
Patriot American is a public real estate investment trust that specializes in hotels.
Its stock was trading at around 45 and 11/16.
